summary: Every identity PIM Manager creates now has a published list of approved rights, and new installs grant fewer rights.

fixes.title: Published rights list for every identity
fixes.text: PIM Manager now ships an approved list of rights for every identity it creates, so Invardia can check the live rights every day.

fixes.title: Fewer rights for the engine on new installs
fixes.text: New installations no longer give the engine three Microsoft permissions it never needs.

fixes.title: Documentation matches the product
fixes.text: The documentation now describes the two-line install, the Community nightly updater, the free second approver, evidence export and time-limited support database access as they work.
